T: Up is down. Dinner is now.
D: Will, Elizabeth and Barbossa sail to the end of the world to bring Jack back from Davy Jones's Locker.
P: Serve the snacks when the Brethren Court gathers at Shipwreck Cove.
S: Steamed pork and shrimp dumplings with soy, black vinegar and chili oil
Pork and prawn dumplings steamed 8 minutes in bamboo baskets, with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.
Jack's honey and smoked salt peanuts
Roasted peanuts glazed with butter, honey and smoked salt, broken into clusters

Peanuts roasted with butter, honey and smoked salt at 180C for 10 minutes, cooled into crunchy clusters. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey and toss through 300g peanuts with a pinch of smoked salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes, stirring once. Cool until crunchy, then break into clusters. A snack fit for a captain in a strange place.
Locker crab and chive brioche toasts
the crabs carrying the Pearl across the sand

Sweet crab meat folded with lemon mayo and chives, piled on golden toasted brioche rounds with a dusting of paprika. Cut 16 rounds from 4 thick slices of brioche with a small cutter, brush with 30g melted butter and toast at 180C for 8 minutes. Drain 250g cooked crab meat well and mix with 3 tbsp mayo, the zest and a squeeze of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper. Pile onto the cooled toasts, dust with sweet paprika and add a few chive tips.
M: Crab pieces in a sweet chili tomato sauce with egg ribbons, crusty bread to mop up
Crab cooked in a sticky sweet chilli tomato sauce with egg ribbons, eaten with bread to mop up.
Maelstrom snapper with lime caper butter
Will and Elizabeth marrying mid-battle in the maelstrom

Snapper fillets pan-fried with crisp skin, spooned with a foaming lime and caper butter, over coconut rice with a mango salad. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Score the skin of 4 snapper fillets, season and fry skin side down in oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, flip and cook 1 minute more. Add 60g butter to the pan, let it foam, then add 1 tbsp capers and the juice of 1 lime. Toss 1 sliced mango with coriander and red onion. Spoon the butter over the fish.
W: Pandan coconut pudding topped with toasted coconut and diced mango
Coconut milk, sugar and pandan paste whisked with cornflour over low heat until thick, poured into glasses and chilled 3 hours, topped with toasted coconut and mango.
K: Gin, cherry liqueur, pineapple, lime and grenadine shaken, over ice with a splash of soda

Gin shaken with cherry liqueur, pineapple, lime and a dash of grenadine and bitters, tall, pink and frothy over ice with a cherry. For each drink, shake 30ml gin, 15ml cherry liqueur, 90ml pineapple juice, 15ml lime juice, 10ml grenadine and a dash of bitters hard with ice until frothy. Strain into a tall glass filled with ice and top with a splash of soda water. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make four, using 120ml gin and 60ml cherry liqueur in total.

s.note: Steamed pork and shrimp dumplings with soy, black vinegar and chili oil
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, soy and salt. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Steam in a lined bamboo basket for 8 minutes. Serve with small dishes of soy sauce, black vinegar and chilli oil for dipping.

m.note: Crab pieces in a sweet chili tomato sauce with egg ribbons, crusty bread to mop up
m.how: Fry 3 garlic cloves, ginger and 2 chillies, add 150ml tomato sauce, 3 tbsp sweet chilli, 1 tbsp soy and 250ml water. Add 1.5kg cleaned crab pieces, cover and cook 10 minutes. Stir in 2 beaten eggs and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Pandan coconut pudding topped with toasted coconut and diced mango
w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar, a teaspoon of pandan paste and 5 tbsp cornflour over low heat until thick and glossy. Pour into glasses and chill for 3 hours. Top with toasted shredded coconut and diced mango. Watch for the green flash.
